title: The scheme theoretic intersection of two closed subspaces is their fibre product
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for closed subspaces Z and Y of an algebraic space X over S, the scheme theoretic intersection Z intersect Y has closed immersion projections to Z and to Y and the displayed square is cartesian, i.e. Z intersect Y = Z x_X Y (source lines 2903-2918). The proof obtains the two closed immersion statements from the ideal description of closed immersions and then concludes that the square is cartesian because the formation of the scheme theoretic intersection commutes with etale localization, reducing the cartesian property to the case of schemes.
